dict.string: My Clara reads your Apple Health data — including steps, sleep, heart rate, workouts, active energy, and exercise minutes — to provide personalized wellness insights and show how your schedule affects your well-being.
My Clara uses clinical records from Apple Health to improve your health insights and wellness recommendations.

My Clara reads your calendar events — including event titles, times, and locations — to display your schedule, detect conflicts between overlapping meetings, and provide AI-powered time management suggestions. For example, Clara may suggest blocking focus time when your afternoon is meeting-free.

My Clara reads your calendar events — including event titles, times, and locations — to display your schedule, detect conflicts between overlapping meetings, and provide AI-powered time management suggestions. For example, Clara may suggest blocking focus time when your afternoon is meeting-free. Full access also lets Clara create events like focus time blocks directly on your calendar.
My Clara reads your reminders to show them alongside your calendar events and help you prioritize your day. For example, Clara may remind you of overdue tasks during a free slot in your schedule.
My Clara needs full access to your reminders to sync reminders created in the app to your iOS Reminders app.

My Clara uses your location to provide weather-aware scheduling suggestions and help you add location details to events. For example, Clara may factor in commute time when suggesting when to leave for your next meeting.
My Clara needs camera access to take photos of your calendar for event import.
My Clara needs photo library access to select calendar screenshots for event import.
